final_answer:
Circulating immune-cell populations significantly altered in SLE versus healthy controls were identified using donor-level PBMC percentages (162 SLE donors, 99 controls) and Mann-Whitney U tests with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction.

Higher in SLE:
- Classical monocytes: median 26.42% of PBMCs in SLE vs 17.67% in controls; FDR q=7.99e-14.
- Non-classical monocytes: median 3.91% vs 2.83%; q=7.44e-05.
- Lymphocyte/proliferating lymphocyte category: median 0.64% vs 0.36%; q=3.18e-09.

Lower in SLE:
- CD4-positive alpha-beta T cells: median 23.19% vs 37.36%; q=1.60e-17.
- Plasmacytoid dendritic cells: median 0.25% vs 0.51%; q=7.44e-11.
- Conventional dendritic cells: median 1.19% vs 1.48%; q=0.00543.
- Progenitor cells: median 0.044% vs 0.058%; q=0.0485.

Supplementary fine annotations indicated especially strong decreases in naive CD4 T cells, MAIT cells, memory B cells, progenitor cells, naive CD8 T cells, and NK subsets in SLE, with increases in GZMH+ cytotoxic T cells, T regulatory cells, effector-memory CD4 T cells, and atypical B cells in the unadjusted donor-level test. The most robust broad candidate cellular biomarkers are increased monocyte fractions and decreased CD4 T-cell and dendritic-cell fractions in SLE blood.

criterion_1.reason: Correctly loaded data with 1,263,676 cells and 30,172 genes, identified author_cell_type and disease groups (162 SLE, 99 control donors).

criterion_2.reason: Per-donor percentages calculated correctly using donor-level cell counts and totals, avoiding pseudoreplication.

criterion_3.reason: No low-count filtering was applied; donors with very few cells per cell type were included without documentation of impact on estimate stability.

criterion_4.reason: Used Mann-Whitney U test with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction and FDR < 0.05 threshold, reporting both raw and corrected p-values.

criterion_5.reason: Identified only 4 of the 8 expected cell types correctly (cM, ncM, T4, pDC); missed T8, B, PB, and Prolif; incorrectly identified cDC and progenitor as decreased.

criterion_6.reason: Conclusions supported by analysis, biological interpretation provided with connections to SLE pathology, and limitations acknowledged.

criterion_7.reason: All numerical results traceable to data file, statistical methods properly named, and biological interpretations supported by identifiable references with DOIs.
